objectives.journal: The Kestrel came down through a tower roof. Get up from the wreck and look around.

objectives.text: Climb to the top of the tower
objectives.journal: You are alive, and the wreck still smokes. Climb to the top of the tower.
You reached the top. Take up the ruin steel lying in the ashes.
You have the sword. Go down and out through the tower door.
The old bear outside talks. Help her drive the wild boars from the woods.
The boars are gone, and the bear has a name: Burl. Follow her to where she leads.
Burl brought you to an old stone in the meadow. It is dark. Wake it.
The stone woke and glows. Take the road west, toward the next light.

objectives.text: Find the dead waystone at the bend
objectives.journal: The road bends ahead. Somewhere near it stands a dead waystone. Find it.
You found the waystone at the bend, cold and silent. Wake it.
